messages:
Alex: Hey team, heads-up — we hit a p95 regression in canary after the kernel flags change.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused at 30% due to latency spike (>120% baseline) :warning:
Maria: Confirming, alerts started ~11:07. Loading logs now.
Sam: Can you paste the deploy-bot output? Also which model version and kernel flag?
Alex: model=redwood-2.1.0-quant, kernel=attn_opt_v3, traffic_slice=usw2-canary
Maria: Logs: `timeout increased on batcher`, `kv cache miss rate +17%`
Eve: Initial triage: looks like batching heuristics misfired with attn_opt_v3 on short sequences.
Sam: Rollback options: 1) full rollback to redwood-2.0.8 (manual revert), 2) pin canary to 2.0.8 and continue rest of rollout, 3) toggle kernel flag back to attn_opt_v2 (soft rollback)
Alex: Preference for soft rollback first (kernel flip) to see if latency recovers. That should be quick and less customer-impacting.
Maria: Agree. Do we have automated guard rails to flip kernel per region?
deploy-bot: Kernel toggle is supported via `rbctl kernel-toggle --region usw2 --from attn_opt_v3 --to attn_opt_v2` (requires operator approval).
Sam: I'll run the command with operator approval. @Eve can you confirm metrics dashboard link and threshold for re-open?
Eve: Metrics pg: https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/1766. Threshold = p95 < 1.2x baseline and error rate < 0.5%.
Alex: Maria, can you draft the short customer-facing note if we need to pin version? Keep it factual: "We briefly paused a canary for a backend performance check..." 
Maria: Draft: "We paused a limited rollout due to an internal latency regression and rolled back an internal kernel flag to restore performance. No customer data was affected. We're monitoring closely. —Maria"
Sam: Running kernel-toggle now. Command: ```rbctl kernel-toggle --region usw2 --from attn_opt_v3 --to attn_opt_v2 --operator sam --confirm``` 
deploy-bot: Kernel toggle started. ETA ~ 45s.
Alex: Watching graphs... p95 dropping already.
Eve: Error rate stable, p95 at 1.05x baseline now.
deploy-bot: Kernel toggle complete. Canary resumed to 35% with new kernel. Rollback not required at this time.
Sam: Leaving a manual pin ready if things re-escalate: `rbctl pin-version --region usw2 --version redwood-2.0.8 --reason "canary p95 regression"`
Maria: Sending internal comms: "Canary paused and kernel toggled; customers unaffected; continue monitoring. If p95 >1.2x for 15m escalate to full rollback." 
Alex: Thanks. Quick postmortem action items: - Add unit test for batching heuristic + attn_opt_v3 on short seqs - Add deploy-bot flag to aut-flip kernel if p95 spike >1.3x for 10m - Run canary for 60m extra before full rollout
Eve: Noted. I'll open the follow-up tickets.
Sam: Closing thread unless we see another spike. :thumbsup:
Alex: Closing. :white_check_mark:
